description: This file defines a plugin for Playwright that gathers Git commit information and CI environment details, and integrates it into test metadata. It includes functions for fetching commit info, diffs, and CI data, and sets up a plugin with a setup hook.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Logs messages prefixed with 'GitCommitInfo: ' to the console.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs debug messages if the environment variable DEBUG_GIT_COMMIT_INFO is set.

methods.name: ciInfo
methods.description: Gathers CI environment information from environment variables and files for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.

methods.name: gitCommitInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the latest Git commit information from a specified directory, including commit hash, author, and branch.

methods.name: gitDiff
methods.description: Computes the diff of uncommitted changes or between a base hash and HEAD, respecting CI environment constraints.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a Git command in a specified directory with a timeout, returning the output or undefined on failure.
